text:
Amal: Quick async — heads up that ownership for the last wave of v2 endpoints is shifting from infra-team -> eng-platform next sprint. Mostly /embed and /rerank. I attached the ownership matrix in the doc but TL;DR: eng-platform to take rollout coordination, infra keeps runtime shims.

Kevin: noted. Can we confirm infra will keep the compatibility shim for the 6-week overlap? We still need it for a handful of older SDK versions in the wild.

Amal: yes, infra will maintain the shim. Plan is: week 0 announce, week 2 canary, week 4 wider rollout, week 6 deprecate old header acceptance. Owners need to own the canary smoke and postmortem checklist.

Sophia: DevEx / SDK update window — we can cut SDK 3.2.0 next Tue which adds the new header `X-Redwood-APIVersion: 2`. Recommend we ship SDK with a deprecation warning printed when calls use old header. Anyone opposed to the SDK printing a single-line warning by default? :warning:

Kevin: ok for me. Runtime note: we should also accept `Accept: application/vnd.redwood+json; version=1` for 6 weeks and log telemetry to flag.

Shawn: Eng-SRE: telemetry + alerting — I will wire a count for requests hitting the shim and a latency delta metric. Please add a trace tag `api.migration=v2` from the SDK so we can slice traces.

Amal: good call. Sophia can you add the trace tag and the warning to the SDK release? Also add a short example in the changelog showing header vs Accept negotiation. e.g.:
```
# header negotiation example
POST /v2/chat HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
X-Redwood-APIVersion: 2
Content-Type: application/json
```

Sophia: yup, I can do that. I'll drop the PR by EOD today and tag @Jordan for review. Also will include a migration snippet for Node and Python.

Jordan: happy to review but ask for a quick checklist: 1) docs update 2) changelog entry 3) SDK warning unit test 4) sample app updated 5) rollout playbook link. I'll run the SDK QA matrix once the PR lands.

Amal: checklist ✅ — I'll link the rollout playbook here once final. One ask: can owners confirm they own the deprecation blog + customer emails? We need marketing sync.

Kevin: infra will scope the shim tests and fallback behavior. We can't do emails; product/marketing should handle comms. Kevin: pinging product to slot email.

Sophia: I can draft the SDK note for marketing to adapt. Will add a checkbox in the PR for the marketing asset.

Shawn: SRE will schedule canary slices: slice A = 5% internal traffic, slice B = 20% opt-in customers. Need owners to nominate a list of internal smoke apps.

Amal: putting a short poll: please reply with an app name for internal smoke by EOD. I put `console-ui`, `ingest-proxy` as starters.

ci-bot: Build queued for branch sdk/3.2.0 - will post status on PR.

Jordan: i'll be the code reviewer for the Node side; @Sophia please request review when ready. Also reminder: update our rollback playbook with the exact feature-flag keys used for routing.

Amal: thanks all. I'll update the doc with owners and the playbook link. If anyone wants to reassign an item ping me directly. Short, concrete asks above — no long meeting needed.
